scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Other ecosystems (e.g. Cosmos chains connected by IBC, Move-based chains) each have…
scenes.vo: Solana: a separate, high-throughput chain with its own wallets (for example Phantom, Solflare), its own address format, very low fees (paid in SOL), and priority fees when busy. Tokens follow its own standard (SPL). Your Ethereum address doesn't work there. Sending between ecosystems needs a bridge or an exchange. Bitcoin in DeFi: bitcoin itself doesn't run DeFi apps, so it's usually used as a wrapped token on other chains (backed by a custodian, a group of signers, or a protocol), or on Bitcoin layer 2s and sidechains. Each wrapper has its own trust model. Your "bitcoin" is only as good as whoever holds the real bitcoin. Other ecosystems (for example Cosmos chains connected by IBC, Move-based chains) each have their own wallets, fees and bridges. Apply Module 5's dependency map to each. Same rules everywhere: official wallet from the official site, test transaction first, correct network, gas token on hand.

Bitcoin in DeFi: BTC itself doesn't run DeFi apps, so it's usually used as a wrapped token on other chains (backed by a custodian, a group of signers, or a protocol), or on Bitcoin layer 2s and sidechains.
